description: Styles the text of a shape or table cell (batchUpdate updateTextStyle): bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, font_family (e.g. "Roboto"), font_size_pt, foreground_color (#RRGGBB) and link_url. Only the provided fields change (the field mask is computed automatically); at least one is required. By default the whole text is styled; pass start_index + end_index (0-based character offsets, end exclusive) to style a range — get the offsets from get_page's textElements. For a table cell add row_index + column_index.

link_url.description: Turns the styled range into a hyperlink.

object_id.description: The shape or table object id whose text to style.

presentation_id.description: The presentation id — the long id from the URL (docs.google.com/presentation/d/<presentationId>/edit) or from create_presentation output.

name: update_text_style
title: Style text
